prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-10-22, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-10-22):
Fiscal period 2025 Q3 (filed 2025-10-22). Revenue 23,993M, gross margin 70%, operating income 7,096M (operating margin 30%), net income 5,152M, diluted EPS 2.12. Total assets 192,816M, total liabilities 113,539M, shareholders' equity 79,277M. Current assets 54,611M vs current liabilities 50,869M (current ratio 1.07), retained earnings 167,281M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The reported metrics indicate exceptional profitability (30% operating margin, 70% gross margin) and a very strong equity base (with retained earnings exceeding total assets), implying low leverage and ample capacity to service obligations. Liquidity is adequate but not exceptional (current ratio just above 1.0), which prevents the highest rating category while still supporting near-top investment-grade status.
DECISION: AA+
